opts: Two new fixed points from one
A limit cycle emerging from a fixed point as a complex conjugate pair of eigenvalues crosses the imaginary axis
exp: Hopf: as a parameter varies, a complex conjugate pair λ(μ)=α(μ)±iω(μ) crosses the imaginary axis (α(μ*)=0). A limit cycle is born (supercritical) or destroyed (subcritical) at μ*. This is how oscillations emerge in dynamical systems.
